messages:
tara-cs: FYI CedarWell wants a short UK demo Thurs 09:00-09:45 UTC. asking for a temporary qps bump and UK-edge allowlist so clinical users see low latency. renewal called out as "at-risk" in CRM unless demo performs. can we support?
devon-sre: sure. Hosted PAYG? need org id, CIDRs, peak qps, and desired SLAs. also recommend a circuit-breaker. @ops-oncall tagging.
tara-cs: yes hosted. org id org-cw-781. CIDRs: 34.72.66.0/24, 34.72.67.0/24. requested peak qps 1,100 (baseline ~160). target p95 < 300ms. window 2026-04-22T09:00:00Z -> 2026-04-22T09:45:00Z.
mira-platform: we can prefer eu-west-2 and add those CIDRs to the proxy allowlist. recommend temp max_qps=1200 with breaker 1500. will enable prefix cache warm for core flows. note: hosted fallbacks to multi-region unless we pin; we can add a transient routing pin for the window.
devon-sre: plan: create temp policy + allowlist, soft cap 1200 qps, breaker 1500, transient route to eu-west-2 for the window. enabling enhanced logs and token traces. snippet to apply (informal):
```json
{"org_id":"org-cw-781","start":"2026-04-22T09:00:00Z","end":"2026-04-22T09:45:00Z","max_qps":"1200","circuit_break_qps":"1500","allowlist":["34.72.66.0/24","34.72.67.0/24"]}
```
deploy-bot: ticket #CS-9123 created -> temp policy + allowlist. assigned to devon-sre. auto-revoke scheduled.
ops-oncall: confirmed capacity in eu-west-2 for that slot; reserving burst. will open a standby channel in #release-war-room and post 15-min checks. please enable session dashboard and real-time alerts.
sam-ae: AE joining demo and renewal call. tara please collect their success metrics so we can quantify win.
tara-cs: i'll send prewarm checklist and ask them to rotate long-lived keys to ephemeral for session. will confirm test prompts at 08:45 UTC. thanks team :thumbsup:
devon-sre: policy pushed -> policy_id=tmp-cw-781-20260422. allowlist applied. dashboard: https://console.redwood.example/org/org-cw-781/session-20260422
ops-oncall: standing by during window; will escalate if latency >350ms or 5xx spike.
tara-cs: perfect 10; will collect post-demo feedback and add notes to renewal record.
